result.markdown:
# Capacity Congestion and High PRB Utilization on S-TUN-005

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** capacity at `S-TUN-005`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct telemetry and alerts show active user and traffic spikes driving PRB utilization to 99.4% on S-TUN-005.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-12 19:30 to 2026-09-12 22:50
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-12 19:30
- **Affected:** S-TUN-005

## Summary

High user traffic surge at site S-TUN-005 saturated physical resource blocks up to 99.4%, causing elevated latency and slow speeds.

Customers around S-TUN-005 experienced very slow speeds and high latency from 2026-09-12 19:30 until 2026-09-12 22:50.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 19:30: Alert ALR-0021 started indicating RRC drop and traffic anomaly on S-TUN-005. [T1, ALR-0021]
- 2026-09-12 19:46: Warning alarm ALM-000233 raised for high PRB utilization on S-TUN-005. [T4, ALM-000233]
- 2026-09-12 20:45: PRB utilization peaked at 99.4% and latency reached 128 ms on S-TUN-005. [T7, ANM-000168]
- 2026-09-12 21:30: Active users peaked at 565 on S-TUN-005. [T7, ANM-000168]
- 2026-09-12 22:50: High PRB utilization alarm ALM-000233 cleared on S-TUN-005. [T4, ALM-000233]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-005 experienced an active users spike to 565 and a downlink volume spike to 36591 MB. [ANM-000168, ANM-000169]
- PRB utilization reached 99.4% and latency spiked to 128 ms on S-TUN-005. [T7]
- Sibling sites S-TUN-003 and S-TUN-006 showed normal PRB utilization and stable latency. [T7]
- No changes were performed on S-TUN-005 or its ancestors during the incident window. [T5]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-005 or its ancestors during the incident window. [T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **capacity** at S-TUN-005: confirmed. Sudden traffic and user spike directly saturated PRB utilization to 99.4% causing severe congestion. [T1, T7, ALR-0021]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-C: rejected. Sibling sites sharing the same fiber link remained completely normal, ruling out shared transport failure. [T2, T7]

## Ruled out

- T3: No external events were recorded for region TUN during the incident window.
- T5: No configuration changes were executed on S-TUN-005 or its parents.
- T8: No maintenance was scheduled for S-TUN-005 or its parent aggregation router.

## Recommended actions

- Upgrade capacity or sector bandwidth on S-TUN-005 to handle recurring localized user surges.
- Monitor active user trends on S-TUN-005 during peak hours.
